reason: My regulars and my Google reviews fill my chairs, and I've never needed creators. A beta app from a small team that pays me ₹200 a month isn't enough to make me start handing out coupons and training staff on PINs.
objection: Will good creators actually be on it, or will it be the same people who DM me for freebies every week, just on an app now?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a salon or gym near me that I know get real, repeat customers from good local creators through it, with the coupon numbers to show for it.
